Good Afternoon Malak,

Apologies for the previous message. We have checked and confirmed that your check-out date is scheduled for 2nd August.

We would like to kindly double-check your security deposit payment, as per our system we have received the full rent payment; however, the deposit amount has not been reflected.

Could you please confirm how the deposit payment was made and share any payment details or proof, if available, so we can verify it with our team?

Once again, we apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and appreciate your cooperation.
